fusions.name: Carve the Roast
fusions.desc: Carves into an enemy at or below 25% health for 16 damage, adding 1.4 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Trencherman's Cleave
fusions.desc: Hacks an arc that deals 7 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Butcher the Carcass
fusions.desc: Butchers every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 12 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
